response.rule: Electronics may be refunded within 30 days of delivery. After 30 days no refund can be issued, including for faults reported later.

after_window.note: Items still under manufacturer warranty can be escalated to a specialist for a warranty review, which may result in a repair or replacement. A specialist decides; support agents cannot promise the outcome.

response.rule: Homeware may be refunded within 60 days of delivery if unused and in its original packaging.

after_window.note: No escalation path after the window for homeware.

default.message: No refund policy is published for that category.
